entries.value: "Shared stdio JSON-RPC 2.0 core for base-studio-code's bundled native MCP servers (#1622) — the `initialize`/`tools/list`/`tools/call` handshake, the request/response builders, the dispatch, and the newline-delimited stdin→stdout run-loop, parameterized by each server's tool catalog + dispatcher (the `ToolServer` trait). Used by `bsc-research-mcp` and `bsc-compliance-mcp` so the JSON-RPC plumbing lives in one tested place while each crate keeps its own tools + arg parsers."

lead: # build.rs parses the committed graph store directly — see crates/graph-materialize/build.rs.
# Pure lib (no Tauri, no async runtime, no I/O beyond the stdio run-loop) so it stays a lightweight
# dependency of the bundled MCP server binaries and the dispatch logic is unit-testable in isolation.
sections.name: [build-dependencies]
